newsitem.title: UK: Montpellier air cargo grows spectacular in Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: Montpellier air cargo grows spectacular in Jan-May.

text.p: Spectacular growth in air cargo traffic handled at Montpellier airport in the first five months of the year was largely due to the impact of additional freighter capacity dedicated to express traffic, an airport authority official told Reuters.
Jan-May 1997 airfreight handled at the southern France gateway totalled 4,458 tonnes, up 132.4 percent on 1996 levels.

Earlier this year, French airline, L'Aeropostale, added a second rotation to its Boeing 737F Paris- Montpellier service, to carry shipments on behalf of express operator, TAT Express and its impact on volumes is now being felt," the official said.

Another French express operator based at Montpellier, Jet Services, had recorded steady growth in traffic since introducing a stopover at Montpellier on its weeknightly BAe146 domestic all- cargo service last year, the official added.
The service's full routing, operated by Jet Services' airline subsidiary, Air Jet, reads: Paris/CDG- Strasbourg-Montpellier-Rennes-Marseille-Paris-CDG.

Airfreight is also carried by airlines operating passenger services to Montpellier, the majority from Paris while the airport is also part of Air France's trucking network. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
